prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need AI for creative, programmatic media buying, personalization, CRM automation, or analytics. That said, here are reputable LA-area options across different needs, plus guidance to pick the right partner.

Agencies and providers to consider (by capability)
- Cognitiv — AI-driven programmatic and performance advertising. Good for automated bidding and scaling digital media.  
- Tinuiti — performance marketing with strong ML/AI capabilities across paid search, social, and marketplaces; good for ecommerce.  
- R/GA — large creative + tech agency with AI/innovation labs; strong for brand-driven, experience-focused AI work.  
- Brainlabs (US operations) — data-driven performance agency that emphasizes automation and experimentation.  
- Accenture Interactive / Deloitte Digital / Merkle (Dentsu) — enterprise-level consulting agencies with deep AI, martech, and systems-integration capabilities. Best if you need complex martech stacks and cross-channel integration.  
- Hawke Media / VaynerMedia — LA-based growth and social-first agencies that use automation and data-driven strategies; better for small-mid enterprises and social/brand growth.  
- Persado / CreativeX (platforms rather than full-service agencies) — AI-driven marketing platforms for message optimization and creative performance; useful if you want to augment in-house teams.

How to choose the right one
1. Define the objective: e.g., increase ROAS, scale acquisition, personalize site/email, automate ad buying, or improve creative performance.  
2. Look for relevant case studies and KPIs in your industry.  
3. Ask about the tech stack: proprietary AI vs. vendor tools (and how they integrate with your martech).  
4. Data & privacy: confirm ownership, access, and compliance (CCPA, GDPR as relevant).  
5. Pilot-first approach: start with a timeboxed test and measurable success criteria.  
6. Team composition: data scientists + media/creative + engineers — not just sales.  
7. Transparent measurement and reporting — what metrics and attribution models they use.  
8. References and small-scope proof (3–6 month pilot recommended).

If you want, tell me:
- Your objective (performance, personalization, creative AI, etc.)  
- Company size and monthly ad spend (if applicable)  
- Budget range and timeline

I can then shortlist 2–3 agencies in LA that best match your needs and draft a short RFP/pilot brief you can send them.
